findings.label: Hover-shade shift in light mode
findings.detail: .read-more:hover and .notice-bio-link:hover were repointed from --primary-dark (#8b2310) to --accent (= --primary #ad2c11 in light mode), slightly lightening the hover red. Deliberate and documented in the plan; cosmetically negligible. Optional fix: a --accent-strong: var(--primary-dark) token for these two hovers to restore exact light-mode parity.
